method: Opened all 9 contact sheets, the negscan sheet and pair_000 to pair_089 (first third of the 270 sorted strip/pair files) one by one with the Read tool; suspect moments re-grabbed as exact full-resolution frames with ffmpeg select=eq(n,FRAME) into a scratch folder and checked (hair-top crops, picture push continuity, frame-difference on the stock clip join, chip timing on the app recording); captions read against beats.json words; labels checked against auto_content_report.json. || Opened all 90 images of the middle third (pair_090 to pair_133, strip_000 to strip_045) one at a time. Exact frames pulled with the ffmpeg select filter into the scratch folder for five checks: frames 5152-5258 (possible hidden cut 172-175 s), frames 1-8 (hair headroom at the open), frames 438/484 (chip beside the face), frames 1767-1776 (jump inside the phone clip), frames 5497-5640 (app screen recording labels). Checked against beats.json flashes, lower thirds, CTAs and deviations. || Opened all 90 images in the last third of the sorted strip list (strip_046 to strip_133, including both files numbered 116 and 117) with the Read tool, one at a time. Suspect spots were re-checked on exact frames pulled with ffmpeg select=eq(n,FRAME) into a private scratch folder: hair top at 105.1 and 109.6 to 111.3, the app-recording chip between 100.8 and 101.6, the burned AI label at 115.3, the dark block at 136.1, a one-frame mouth change at 174.27 (every frame 174.24 to 175.21 plus the picture EDL and word timings), the text-plate windows at 92 to 98 and 191 to 197, the phone window at 183 to 191, and the last frames. Flash returns were matched to the flashes and flash_dropped lists in beats.json. No pair_* images fall in this share.
